preconditions.description: The number of junctions n and roads m are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct junctions within the valid range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == len(set(tuple(sorted((u, v))) for u, v in edges))
preconditions.description: No two roads connect the same pair of intersections (no duplicate edges).

postconditions.description: The output is either 'NO' or starts with 'YES' followed by exactly three lines describing the routes.

postconditions.expression: output == 'NO' or (output.startswith('YES') and all(len(route.split()) >= 2 and int(route.split()[0]) == len(route.split()) - 1 for route in output.strip().split(chr(10))[1:]))
postconditions.description: If YES, each route line contains the count of nodes followed by that many node identifiers.

postconditions.expression: output == 'NO' or (output.startswith('YES') and routes[0][0] == routes[1][0] == routes[2][0] and routes[0][-1] == routes[1][-1] == routes[2][-1] and routes[0][0] != routes[0][-1])
postconditions.description: If YES, all three routes start at the same junction and end at the same junction, which must be different from the start.

postconditions.expression: output == 'NO' or (output.startswith('YES') and all(len(set(route)) == len(route) for route in routes))
postconditions.description: If YES, no route visits the same intersection twice (simple paths).

postconditions.expression: output == 'NO' or (output.startswith('YES') and all(len(set(route[1:-1])) == len(route[1:-1]) and len(set(route[1:-1]) & set(other[1:-1])) == 0 for route in routes for other in routes if route is not other))
postconditions.description: If YES, the internal nodes (excluding start and end) of any two routes are disjoint.

postconditions.expression: output == 'NO' or (output.startswith('YES') and all((u, v) not in edge_set and (v, u) not in edge_set for route in routes for u, v in zip(route, route[1:]) for other in routes if route is not other for x, y in zip(other, other[1:]) if (u, v) == (x, y) or (u, v) == (y, x)))
postconditions.description: If YES, no two routes share any road (edge), regardless of direction.

postconditions.expression: output == 'NO' or (output.startswith('YES') and all((u, v) in edge_set or (v, u) in edge_set for route in routes for u, v in zip(route, route[1:])))
postconditions.description: If YES, every consecutive pair of nodes in each route corresponds to an existing road in the input.
